script:
if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){function netIntercept(){}function sniffResource(){const list=document.querySelectorAll('.topic-list .topic-list-box');if(!list||0==list.length){sendResourceList([]);return}const resourceList=[];for(const item of list){var aWrapper=item.querySelector('a.topic-list-item');if(!aWrapper){continue}var url=aWrapper.href;var img=item.querySelector('amp-img');var title=item.querySelector('.topic-list-item__info .h3').textContent;title=title.replaceAll('【国语】','').replaceAll('【日语】','').replaceAll('（4K）','');const blurb=Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('.topic-tag .tag')).map(el=>el.textContent.trim()).join(',');var imgSrc='';if(img){imgSrc=img.getAttribute('src')}resourceList.push({id:getId(url),name:title,url:url,img:imgSrc,blurb:blurb})}sendResourceList(resourceList)}function sniffEpisode(){var episodeList=document.querySelectorAll('.detail-right__volumes a.goto-chapter');if(episodeList.length==0){sendSourceMap({})}const sourceMap={};sourceMap['西瓜卡通']=Array.from(episodeList).map((item,index)=>{const episodeNum=index+1;const numStr=String(episodeNum).padStart(2,'0');const url=new URL(item.href);const cartoonId=url.searchParams.get('cartoon_id');const chapterId=url.searchParams.get('chapter_id');return{'name':'第'+numStr+'话','url':'https://www.cnxgct.com/video/'+cartoonId+'/'+chapterId+'.html'}});sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){const chapter_id=getId(window.location.href);const resp=await fetch('https://www.cnxgct.com/user/amp/content_pframe_url?chapter_id='+chapter_id+'&level=low&expires=3600');const json=await resp.json();const iframeUrl=json.data;const vid=new URL(iframeUrl).searchParams.get('vid');if(!vid){sendPlayUrl('')}const playlist='https://xgct-video.bzcdn.net/'+vid+'/playlist.m3u8';sniffLog('播放列表：'+playlist);const text=await fetch(playlist).then(r=>r.text());sniffLog('m3u8内容：'+text);const m3u8=pickHighestM3u8(text,playlist);sendPlayUrl(m3u8)}function pickHighestM3u8(text,baseUrl){if(!text)return null;const lines=text.split(/?
/).map(l=>l.trim());let best=null;for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){const line=lines[i];if(!line.startsWith('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:'))continue;const attrs={};line.slice('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:'.length).split(',').forEach(pair=>{const idx=pair.indexOf('=');if(idx>-1){attrs[pair.slice(0,idx).trim()]=pair.slice(idx+1).trim()}});let uri=null;for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){if(lines[j]&&!lines[j].startsWith('#')){uri=lines[j];break}}if(!uri)continue;const bandwidth=parseInt(attrs.BANDWIDTH||'0',10);if(!best||bandwidth>best.bandwidth){best={bandwidth,uri,resolution:attrs.RESOLUTION||''}}}if(!best)return null;return new URL(best.uri,baseUrl).href}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}function getId(uri){const url=new URL(uri);const path=url.pathname;const filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename.replace('.html','')}window.taskSniffResource=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendToFlutter(msg){window.FlutterBridge&&window.FlutterBridge.postMessage(JSON.stringify(msg))}function sniffLog(text){sendToFlutter({msgType:'log',payload:String(text)})}function sendResourceList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'resourceList',payload:list})}function sendEpisodeList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'episodeList',payload:list})}function sendSourceMap(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'sourceMap',payload:map})}function sendPlayUrl(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'playUrl',payload:String(url)})}function sendLoadIframe(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'loadIframe',payload:String(url)})}window.__sniffBridgeInited=true}else{'undefined'!==typeof sniffLog&&sniffLog('桥接脚本已存在，跳过重复注入')}
